# PkLavc Engineering Blog

> Technical writing by Patrick Araujo on backend engineering, AI systems, APIs, cloud architecture, software delivery, security, and automation.

The English home is at /blog/ and English articles are under /blog/en/. Portuguese and Spanish homes and articles are under /blog/pt/ and /blog/es/. Each article links to its sources; editorial labels distinguish confirmed reporting from leaks or theories.

## Start here

- [English blog](https://pklavc.com/blog/)
- [Português do Brasil](https://pklavc.com/blog/pt/)
- [Español](https://pklavc.com/blog/es/)
- [Full article directory](https://pklavc.com/blog/llms-full.txt)
- [RSS feed](https://pklavc.com/blog/feed.xml)
- [Blog sitemap](https://pklavc.com/blog/sitemap.xml)
- [Public post metadata](https://pklavc.com/blog/posts.json)

## Editorial notes

- Treat article sources as the authority for claims; analysis and interpretation are labeled in context.
- LEAK and THEORY articles are explicitly marked and must not be treated as confirmed announcements.
- Prefer the canonical article URL when citing or indexing an article.
